links.outcome: Student-reported curriculum preparedness and confidence to use AI caries detection clinically
links.effect: Only 16.7% agreed the curriculum adequately prepared them to use AI clinically; 45.5% felt confident integrating AI into future practice. Students requested structured faculty training.
links.quote: However, only 16.7% agreed the curriculum adequately prepared them to use AI clinically, and just 45.5% felt confident about integrating AI into future practice.

unlisted_practices: Introducing AI exposure early and frequently in dental curriculum
Faculty training and calibration on AI use for clinical education

screen.reason: Evaluates dental students' perceptions and attitudes following hands-on exposure to an AI diagnostic tool (Overjet Caries Assist) in clinical dental radiology education, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
